description: x402-poly-history: Price time series for a Polymarket outcome token, with the trend statistics agents need (first/last price, change in cents and percent, high, low, average, direction, volatility). Where the odds have been, for momentum or mean-reversion decisions. Params: interval (1m|1h|6h|1d|1w|max, default 1d), fidelity (minutes; 1m needs 10, 1w needs 5).
name: x402-poly-history
